title: urginea maritima subsp. pancration
intro: Urginea maritima subsp. pancration, commonly known as Sea Squill, is a bulbous perennial plant in the Asparagaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it useful for treating various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Sea Squill include stimulating circulation, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities. Additionally, it has been traditionally used to treat conditions such as coughs, colds, and bronchitis, as well as to reduce symptoms of asthma and other respiratory diseases.
